verdict.rationale: Justworks is a SaaS payroll/PEO platform holding sensitive employee data, so whether customer data is excluded from AI model training, or whether users can opt out, is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack covers only payroll, benefits, time off, onboarding and the Xero integration. It contains no AI-training policy, opt-out control or data-use commitment, so the capability is unevidenced.
